<!--
What this changes and why. For anything beyond a small fix, link the issue
where the design was settled.
-->

- [ ] `make check` and `make lint` pass
- [ ] Tests hold the change, and a test of a rule is named for it
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased, if a user of the library would notice the change
- [ ] Doc comments and the README say what the code now does
